stem: What is the approximate distance from the starting line to the beginning of the longest straight section of the track?
steps: Identify where speed is highest and most sustained (longest flat top on graph)
The longest straight section starts at approximately 1.5 km

rubric.description: Correct answer: approximately 1.5 km from the starting line

rating.description: Correct answer by correctly reading the graph
Answer is close but slightly off (e.g. 1.3 or 1.7 km) suggesting approximate graph reading
